identity.title: [v0.92.1][INT-01] Run integrated independent review and remediation

values.task_boundary: Implement only INT-01 within its exact owned paths and authority boundary.
deliverables: Findings-first integrated review at exact lane revisions.
Disposition and remediation ledger with a bounded release recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: CORP-08, V3-16, and DRT-07 are terminal and exact revisions are ancestral to the review revision.
Every required lane artifact and quality gate is independently recomputed or explicitly rejected.
All P1/P2 findings receive verified terminal dispositions before recommendation.
The review does not treat one lane's success as evidence for another lane.
